rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for work or a task that is arduous or demanding.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the effort or energy required to do something.

example.english: Moving this table is really burdensome.
example.jyutping: bun1 ni1 zoeng1 toi2 zan1 hai6 fai3 lik6

rows.note: Use this slice when burdensome means troublesome or inconvenient rather than physically arduous.

example.english: After changing the address, mailing the card again is burdensome.
example.traditional: 改地址之後要再寄張卡，好麻煩。
example.jyutping: goi2 dei6 zi2 zi1 hau6 jiu3 zoi3 gei3 zoeng1 kaa1 hou2 maa4 faan4
